what: Zurn Elkay makes water products for buildings: drains, backflow preventers, flush valves and commercial faucets under Zurn, and drinking fountains and bottle fillers under Elkay.
customers: Plumbing contractors and specifiers fitting out schools, hospitals, stadiums and commercial buildings.
money: drainage, water control and commercial brassware
Elkay fountains, bottle filling stations and filtration
moat: Products written into building specifications and plumbing codes, sold through wholesalers, where the specification rather than the price decides what gets installed.
risks: Non-residential construction has been weak and sets most of the demand
26 times earnings for a business growing in the mid single digits
Copper and brass costs move the margin
opportunities: A 11.7% net margin and $387M of free cash flow on $1.8B of revenue
Revenue grew from $911M to $1.7B in four years, largely through the Elkay merger
Analysts see about 19% upside, and bottle filling stations are replacing fountains in schools everywhere
watch: Organic sales growth and the Elkay merger's cost savings.
